name: structlet
description: Local-first web editor for system architecture diagrams

scripts.lint: node scripts/check-comments.mjs && oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json --deny-warnings src tests scripts vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.deps: depcruise src tests scripts vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs
scripts.build:single: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode single && node scripts/rename-single.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run deps && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:single
